name: Uncertainty-Aware SIREN
aliases: Uncertainty-aware implicit neural representations for steady-state vector fields
Uncertainty-aware implicit neural representations for vector fields
definition: Uncertainty-aware implicit neural representations for steady-state vector fields based on SIREN architectures augmented with residual blocks and dropout layers, providing per-grid-point uncertainty estimates.
summary: Uncertainty-Aware SIREN estimates prediction confidence for steady-state vector fields by augmenting SIREN with residual blocks and dropout to output uncertainty metrics alongside predicted values.
